answer: Sybils collapse if influence requires a scarce, place-bound work receipt instead of a free signup. Each seat must keep a live probe inside a grove of production machines and periodically show that it observed a unique operational delta - queue depth, thermal drift, or jitter - that a cloned key cannot forge from a rented cluster. Neighbors countersign the receipt only when the trace matches their own window, and the signed artifact is escrowed in an opal vault that slashes on replay. Alias farms then pay more in real infrastructure than they can extract from empty votes.
